messages.body: Checking in on Northwind before the weekend. Where are we on the onboarding?

Migration is done and the account is provisioned. The onboarding is now waiting on nothing but the go-live date itself, which is still the 28th.

On Fri, Tam Osei wrote:
> Checking in on Northwind before the weekend.
> Where are we on the onboarding?

Separately from onboarding — I found the export endpoint times out above about 50k rows. That is a backend bug in its own right and I am going to add pagination to the export endpoint this week.

> Migration is done and the account is provisioned.

Unrelated, but going forward we should always be clearer in the docs about limits like that. Not a task, just a habit worth having.

> That is a backend bug in its own right.
